Common questions

Anything to clear up?

Does Finrock actually file with HMRC?+

Yes. VAT and Making Tax Digital returns are submitted through your own HMRC connection — you authorise Finrock against your Government Gateway, review the figures on screen, and file. Every submission is logged both ways, so you can always see exactly what HMRC received and when.

What does the Free plan include?+

The whole personal side — My Life records, renewals, documents, net worth, spending — plus a small business allowance: 10 business entries a month, invoicing for 3 clients, statement import and AI categorisation. The live bank feed and filing are Standard features.

Why do your prices include VAT when others don’t?+

Because most sole traders can’t reclaim it. A "£19 + VAT" plan really costs £22.80. Finrock’s £25 is £25 — the comparison is honest only when both numbers are what actually leaves your account.

Do I need an accountant to use Finrock?+

No. Standard keeps the books, works out what you owe under current UK rules and files it with HMRC — that is a complete, compliant service on its own. Plus exists for the extra confidence: for £10 a month more a qualified UK accountant checks the return, signs it off before it goes, and answers your questions in writing. Your own accountant can also be invited free on any plan.

Is one app really for personal AND business?+

Yes — that’s the point. One ledger holds both, each transaction marked business or personal as you sort it. Your business books stay clean for filing, your personal money powers your Self Assessment estimate, and a limited company gets its own separate workspace and books.

Is my data safe?+

Bank connections are read-only Open Banking — Finrock can never move your money and never sees your bank login. Data is encrypted, held under UK jurisdiction, and you can export or delete everything from Settings.

Can I cancel anytime?+

Yes, in one tap from Settings. Access runs to the end of the billing period, your data exports as CSV, and the Free plan stays free.
